SELECT s.supplier_id, s.company_name,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.suppliers s
JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, s.supplier_id

SELECT cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cd.customer_type_id

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.country AS employee_country,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cross_border_orders,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS cross_border_revenue
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.ship_country IS NOT NULL AND o.ship_country <> e.country
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.country
ORDER BY cross_border_orders DESC, e.employee_id

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.freight,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.freight
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month,
       SUM(freight) AS total_freight,
       SUM(order_revenue) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(freight) / NULLIF(SUM(order_revenue), 0) AS freight_ratio
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date
ORDER BY freight_ratio DESC, month

SELECT c.country,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.country

SELECT s.shipper_id, s.company_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN o.shipped_date > o.required_date THEN (o.shipped_date - o.required_date)::numeric END) AS avg_late_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY avg_late_days DESC NULLS LAST, late_orders DESC, s.shipper_id

GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, e.employee_id

WITH employee_regions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT et.employee_id, t.region_id
    FROM public.employee_territories et
    JOIN public.territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id
)
SELECT r.region_id, r.region_description,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.region r
JOIN employee_regions er ON er.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = er.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_description
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.region_id

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS avg_basket
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
)
SELECT customer_id, company_name, order_count, avg_basket
FROM customer_stats
WHERE order_count >= (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM customer_stats)
  AND avg_basket < (SELECT AVG(avg_basket) FROM customer_stats)
ORDER BY order_count DESC, avg_basket ASC, customer_id

WITH customer_months AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS monthly_revenue,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS monthly_orders
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT cm.customer_id,
           MIN(cm.month) AS first_month,
           MAX(cm.month) AS last_month,
           SUM(cm.monthly_orders) AS total_orders
    FROM customer_months cm
    GROUP BY cm.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(cm.monthly_orders) >= 5
),
first_revenue AS (
    SELECT fl.customer_id, cm.monthly_revenue AS first_revenue
    FROM first_last fl
    JOIN customer_months cm ON cm.customer_id = fl.customer_id AND cm.month = fl.first_month
),
last_revenue AS (
    SELECT fl.customer_id, cm.monthly_revenue AS last_revenue
    FROM first_last fl
    JOIN customer_months cm ON cm.customer_id = fl.customer_id AND cm.month = fl.last_month
)
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name,
       fr.first_revenue, lr.last_revenue,
       (lr.last_revenue - fr.first_revenue) AS revenue_growth,
       (lr.last_revenue - fr.first_revenue) / NULLIF(fr.first_revenue, 0) AS growth_rate
FROM public.customers c
JOIN first_last fl ON fl.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN first_revenue fr ON fr.customer_id = fl.customer_id
JOIN last_revenue lr ON lr.customer_id = fl.customer_id
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC NULLS LAST, c.customer_id

WITH cat_month_rev AS (
    SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM public.categories c
    JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
)
SELECT category_id, category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS n_months,
       STDDEV(monthly_revenue) AS revenue_stddev,
       AVG(monthly_revenue) AS avg_monthly_revenue,
       STDDEV(monthly_revenue) / NULLIF(AVG(monthly_revenue), 0) AS volatility_cv
FROM cat_month_rev
GROUP BY category_id, category_name
ORDER BY volatility_cv DESC, category_id

SELECT s.shipper_id, s.company_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (o.shipped_date - o.required_date) > 3) AS very_late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (o.shipped_date - o.required_date) > 3)::numeric
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS very_late_ratio
FROM public.shippers s
JOIN public.orders o ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id
WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL AND o.required_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY very_late_ratio DESC, s.shipper_id

WITH cat_supplier_rev AS (
    SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, s.supplier_id, s.company_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS supplier_revenue
    FROM public.categories c
    JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, s.supplier_id, s.company_name
),
cat_totals AS (
    SELECT category_id, category_name, SUM(supplier_revenue) AS category_revenue
    FROM cat_supplier_rev
    GROUP BY category_id, category_name
),
cat_shares AS (
    SELECT csr.category_id, csr.category_name, csr.supplier_id, csr.company_name,
           csr.supplier_revenue, ct.category_revenue,
           csr.supplier_revenue / NULLIF(ct.category_revenue, 0) AS supplier_share
    FROM cat_supplier_rev csr
    JOIN cat_totals ct ON ct.category_id = csr.category_id
)
SELECT category_id, category_name, supplier_id, company_name, supplier_revenue, category_revenue, supplier_share
FROM cat_shares
WHERE supplier_share >= 0.60
ORDER BY supplier_share DESC, category_id

WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.company_name,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS gross_revenue,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * od.discount) AS discount_amount,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS net_revenue
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_id, c.company_name
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT customer_id, company_name,
           SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue), 0) AS discount_rate,
           AVG(net_revenue) AS avg_net_per_order
    FROM customer_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id, company_name
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(discount_rate) AS avg_discount_rate,
           AVG(avg_net_per_order) AS avg_net
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT cs.customer_id, cs.company_name, cs.discount_rate, cs.avg_net_per_order
FROM customer_stats cs, averages a
WHERE cs.discount_rate > a.avg_discount_rate
  AND cs.avg_net_per_order < a.avg_net
ORDER BY cs.discount_rate DESC, cs.customer_id

WITH pair_counts AS (
    SELECT od1.product_id AS p1, od2.product_id AS p2,
           COUNT(DISTINCT od1.order_id) AS pair_count
    FROM public.order_details od1
    JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    GROUP BY od1.product_id, od2.product_id
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT od.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT od.order_id) AS product_count
    FROM public.order_details od
    GROUP BY od.product_id
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders FROM public.order_details
),
lift AS (
    SELECT pc.p1, pc.p2, p1_cat.category_id AS p1_cat, p2_cat.category_id AS p2_cat,
           pc.pair_count,
           (pc.pair_count::numeric * tor.n_orders) /
             NULLIF(pr1.product_count * pr2.product_count, 0) AS lift_value
    FROM pair_counts pc
    CROSS JOIN total_orders tor
    JOIN product_counts pr1 ON pr1.product_id = pc.p1
    JOIN product_counts pr2 ON pr2.product_id = pc.p2
    JOIN public.products p1_cat ON p1_cat.product_id = pc.p1
    JOIN public.products p2_cat ON p2_cat.product_id = pc.p2
    WHERE p1_cat.category_id <> p2_cat.category_id
)
SELECT l.p1, pr1.product_name AS product_1, l.p1_cat,
       l.p2, pr2.product_name AS product_2, l.p2_cat,
       l.pair_count, l.lift_value
FROM lift l
JOIN public.products pr1 ON pr1.product_id = l.p1
JOIN public.products pr2 ON pr2.product_id = l.p2
WHERE l.lift_value > 1.0
ORDER BY l.lift_value DESC, l.p1, l.p2

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.freight,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_date, o.freight
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date AS month,
           SUM(freight) / NULLIF(SUM(order_revenue), 0) AS freight_ratio
    FROM order_totals
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::date
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT month, freight_ratio,
           LAG(freight_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_ratio
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, freight_ratio, prev_ratio, (freight_ratio - prev_ratio) AS ratio_increase
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio_increase DESC NULLS LAST, month

WITH supplier_stats AS (
    SELECT s.supplier_id, s.company_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS total_products,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) FILTER (WHERE od.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS sold_products
    FROM public.suppliers s
    JOIN public.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
    LEFT JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name
)
SELECT supplier_id, company_name, total_products, sold_products,
       sold_products::numeric / NULLIF(total_products, 0) AS sold_ratio
FROM supplier_stats
ORDER BY sold_ratio ASC, total_products DESC, supplier_id

       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.categories c
JOIN public.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS total_order_value
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 10
ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, c.customer_id

SELECT s.shipper_id, s.company_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_shipments,
       COUNT(*) AS total_shipments
FROM public.shippers s
JOIN public.orders o ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id
GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name
ORDER BY s.shipper_id

SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.employees e
JOIN public.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name,
       SUM(od.quantity) AS quantity_sold
FROM public.products p
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY quantity_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5

SELECT s1.company_name AS supplier_1, s2.company_name AS supplier_2,
       COUNT(DISTINCT od1.order_id) AS co_order_count
FROM public.order_details od1
JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id <> od2.product_id
JOIN public.products p1 ON p1.product_id = od1.product_id
JOIN public.products p2 ON p2.product_id = od2.product_id
JOIN public.suppliers s1 ON s1.supplier_id = p1.supplier_id
JOIN public.suppliers s2 ON s2.supplier_id = p2.supplier_id
WHERE s1.supplier_id < s2.supplier_id
GROUP BY s1.company_name, s2.company_name
ORDER BY co_order_count DESC, s1.company_name, s2.company_name
LIMIT 10

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.country,
           SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_total
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, c.country
)
SELECT country, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC, country

SELECT s.shipper_id,
       s.company_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN o.shipped_date > o.required_date THEN (o.shipped_date - o.required_date)::numeric END) AS avg_late_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders
FROM public.orders o
